candidate.artifacts: private local research builds only; never commit or ship fitted coefficients

analysis.interpretation: development diagnostic only, cannot establish Elo or shipping admission
analysis.timing: report actual per-side cost and imbalance, no exact wall-time equality claim
analysis.unit: historical opening pair; not proven independent family

matches.dispatch: fixed budget, registered opening order, candidate White then Black; complete four-game waves
matches.repetition: complete prefix and generated game position history at every move
matches.selection: ascending SHA256('natural-runtime-v1|'+original opening index), first20 of100 historical exposed openings
matches.terminal: legal checkmate/stalemate/insufficient material/threefold/fifty-move; ply cap is a separately counted diagnostic draw
matches.validation: independent full legal replay, repetition/terminal result check and complete registered game coverage
matches.watchdogFailure: invalidate complete run, preserve partial evidence; not a chess loss

microbench.engineOrder: alternate baseline-first/candidate-first by repeat and position
microbench.selection: first32 admitted shared-train row IDs lexicographically within each phase

parity.rows: all admitted shared-train, hce-validation and once-opened hce-test; plus authored mapping fixtures

privateSizeGate.rationale: at most 2% additional private payload before spending on matches; production byte ratchet remains unchanged

stopRule.claimDespiteNumericalPass: no production or Elo claim; existing PR146/formal-family/signature/device gates remain
stopRule.gateFailure: stop this runtime stage; preserve evidence; no weight retune, ablation rescue or formal holdout access
